text: The Singapore government will introduce new measures to support small and medium-sized enterprises.
referenceTranslation: 新加坡政府将推出新措施，以支持中小型企业。

text: 政府将继续改善公共交通网络，为居民提供更便捷的出行选择。
referenceTranslation: The government will continue to improve the public transport network and provide residents with more convenient travel options.

text: The new policy aims to make public housing more affordable for young families and first-time buyers.
referenceTranslation: 这项新政策旨在让年轻家庭和首次购房者更能负担得起公共住房。

text: 有关部门将通过数字化服务简化申请流程，并缩短公众的等待时间。
referenceTranslation: The relevant authorities will simplify the application process through digital services and shorten waiting times for the public.

text: Singapore is strengthening cooperation with regional partners to improve food and energy security.
referenceTranslation: 新加坡正加强与区域伙伴的合作，以提升粮食和能源安全。

text: 这项计划预计将在未来三年内为一万名求职者提供技能培训。
referenceTranslation: The programme is expected to provide skills training to ten thousand job seekers over the next three years.

text: To meet its climate goals, Singapore plans to reduce emissions while maintaining economic competitiveness.
referenceTranslation: 为实现气候目标，新加坡计划在保持经济竞争力的同时减少排放。

text: 政府表示，在制定长期人口政策时，将充分考虑经济需求和社会凝聚力。
referenceTranslation: The government said that both economic needs and social cohesion would be fully considered when formulating long-term population policies.

text: Public feedback collected during the consultation will be reviewed before the proposed regulations are finalised.
referenceTranslation: 在拟议条例最终确定之前，有关方面将审议咨询期间收集的公众反馈。

text: 新预算案将重点帮助低收入家庭应对生活成本上涨所带来的压力。
referenceTranslation: The new budget will focus on helping lower-income families cope with pressures arising from the rising cost of living.
